name: page2ai
description: Convert a web page URL (or HTML you already have) to clean Markdown for LLM context: headings, code blocks with language hints, tables and tab panels kept, navigation dropped. Runs the page2ai-mcp server locally through npx; with the optional Agent Bridge key, pages open in your own browser with its cookies.

bridge_key.title: Agent Bridge key (optional)
bridge_key.description: Leave empty unless you want pages to open in your own browser. In the Page2AI browser extension 1.6.0 or later: open its popup, turn on Agent Bridge, allow site access, press Copy key, and paste the key here.
